data.narrative:
Blackstar is a Seed-stage AI & Software company founded by Daniel Edrisian, former OpenAI Codex engineer whose prior venture (Alex, YC W24) was acqui-hired by OpenAI in September 2025. The company has raised $12M to date. The broader AI & Software sector includes one public comparable (Palantir) and eight private peers including Figure AI, Scale AI, and Reflection AI, though narrow-stage peer matching yielded insufficient datapoints for robust median analysis.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable valuation approach. Using the $12M total raised as a base proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $30M. Peer-median triangulation was not applicable due to lack of sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with directly comparable valuation tiers within the AI & Software universe.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $26M–$34M, with a median estimate of $30M. Key uncertainties center on the scarcity of tightly matched private peers at this stage and the rapid evolution of founder-track records in frontier AI, which limits historical precedent. The estimate is sensitive to assumed step-up multiples and would benefit from additional market data as the company progresses toward Series A.
